column1: # Android 2.1 assets copied from the Nexus One image by docs/tools/ec-assets.py: <output>
# Status bar and notification panel (framework-res: status_bar.xml, status_bar_expanded.xml, status_bar_latest_event.xml)
# Live wallpapers (app/LiveWallpapers.apk; the Nexus one is the image's default_wallpaper_component)
# Framework UI (icon menu, AlertDialog, toast; ec-ui.js)
# Home screen widgets (ec-widgets.js): Settings' Power control, GenieWidget's News and Weather
# Launcher2 WallpaperChooser (array/wallpapers, hdpi) and its picker's labels
# Activity windows and preference lists (ec-ui.js window(), ec-settings.js)
# ChooseLockPattern and the pattern unlock screen (LockPatternView)
# Wi-Fi settings (WifiSettings, AccessPointPreference's wifi_signal level lists, ProgressCategory's spinner)
# Contacts.apk DialtactsActivity: twelve_key_dialer (layout-long-finger), tabs, call log, contact list
